label: Column
description: A vertical slot in a row that spans 1–12 of the grid's 12 columns and stacks its children top to bottom. Columns hold the actual content of a page: cards, tab groups, single fields, display elements, collections, activity, and actions.
usage: Use span 8 for primary content and span 4 for a sidebar of key properties and actions.
Prefer cards inside columns over loose fields, so related fields read as one block.
Set spanTablet only when a desktop split would be too narrow on tablets, e.g. 4/4/4 on desktop becomes 12/6/6 on tablet.
constraints: Parent must be layout.row; span is required (1–12) and spans in a row must sum to 12.
spanTablet, when set, is 1–12 and follows the row's tablet sum rule.
Children must be cards, tab groups, field placements, display, collection, or activity elements, action.button, action.action_menu, action.transition_buttons, or action.quick_create.

spanTablet.description: Tablet width in grid columns; defaults to span.

binding.description: Structural only; children bind to the page's record.

accessibility.keyboard: Not focusable. Focus moves through its children top to bottom.
accessibility.notes: Presentational; children provide their own landmarks and names.

responsive: Width follows span on desktop and spanTablet (or span) on tablet; full width below 720px. Children keep their order when stacked.

examples.description: Sidebar column with transition buttons and an assignment card
